clips.title: The story
paras: At Northshire, Tainted Letter calls novice human warlocks away from the Abbey guards for instruction in the fel arts. Drusilla La Salle entrusts it to Marshal McBride, who delivers it to her recruits.

Novice warlocks receive a letter from Marshal McBride after proving themselves against the kobold menace. While priests and paladins study openly in Northshire Abbey, warlocks must tread carefully. Drusilla La Salle's insignia marks the letter, which directs each fledgling spellcaster to her secluded post outside the abbey's main walls before taking on other duties.

Drusilla warns that warlocks walk a precarious path under the watchful eyes of Stormwind's guards, whom she calls 'pathetic mundanes.' Drawing power from the Twisting Nether and communing with demons always risk corruption. She counsels patience, prudence, and firm self-control when handling those dark energies, but says caution must not extinguish a warlock's ambition.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, friend. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Drusilla, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, so you've arrived, and not a moment too soon, friend. Some of the guards were over here a moment ago and were giving me curious looks... Pathetic mundanes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you grow in power, you will be tempted--you must always remember to control yourself. I will not lie--corruption can come to any practitioner of the arcane; especially one who deals with creatures from the Twisting Nether. Be patient, and be prudent... But do not let that repress your ambition.
As you grow more powerful, return to me and I will teach you more about our ways.
